creation_method: Original examples authored by current Codex assistant; deterministic checks and second-pass self-review; no external API batch.
training_format: System message from system.txt, then context_messages, then target_response as assistant completion. Loss on target_response only; historical assistant turns are context. Use native Qwen chat template with enable_thinking=False. Metadata is never model input.
split_policy: All variants of a scenario_family must stay together; this pilot is training-candidate material only.
contamination_limit: No dev/test files, archived tests, or benchmark outputs read during this task. Author has prior conversational exposure to live chat examples; accidental semantic overlap cannot be excluded. Novelty against held-out data not measured.
evaluation: No trained-model experiment or independent judge performed.
